forms.title: A multi-step form that keeps its state
forms.summary: An example approach to form flows where validation and server errors should not erase a person’s work.
forms.problem: A long form is split into steps. A validation error or a failed save sends the user back through the flow, and it is unclear which fields need attention or whether the entered data is still safe.
approach: Keep form state and validation rules explicit for each step.
Show field-level feedback and a clear summary for errors returned by the server.
Preserve entered values when a request fails and make retry actions clear.
forms.validation: Check that values survive validation and network failures, and that each error can be found and corrected using a keyboard or screen reader.

ksef.title: A more reliable KSeF integration flow
ksef.summary: An illustrative integration design for handling invoice validation, temporary failures and repeated delivery safely.
ksef.problem: An invoicing system sends documents to an external service. Requests can be rejected or temporarily unavailable, while an automatic retry may accidentally send the same document twice.
approach: Validate outgoing data before sending and keep rejection details available to the operator.
Queue work and make retry decisions from the service response instead of retrying blindly.
Record a stable document reference and processing state so retries can be idempotent.
ksef.validation: Exercise accepted, rejected, delayed and repeated-request scenarios in a test environment before any production rollout.

imports.title: Repeatable imports from data files
imports.summary: An example workflow for importing recurring files without hiding malformed rows or creating avoidable duplicates.
imports.problem: A team receives data files on a schedule. Small changes in column names, empty values or date formats make manual imports inconsistent and difficult to repeat.
approach: Normalize and validate each row before it reaches the application data.
Return a useful report that points to the affected rows instead of failing without context.
Make repeat runs safe and separate rejected records from accepted ones.
imports.validation: Test valid, malformed, duplicate and partially invalid files, then confirm that rerunning the same input does not create duplicate records.
